in_sanskrit.name: जयश्री
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Jayashree' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jaya' meaning 'victorious, triumphant' and 'Shree' meaning 'prosperous, wealthy'. It implies one who is victorious and prosperous in all aspects of life.

in_hindi.name: जयश्री
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Jayashree' in Hindi is a combination of the words 'Jaya' meaning 'victorious, triumphant' and 'Shree' meaning 'prosperous, wealthy'. It signifies one who is victorious in all aspects of life and is blessed with prosperity and wealth.

in_tamil.name: ஜயச்சிரி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name 'Jayasiri' is derived from the Tamil words 'Jaya' meaning 'victorious' and 'Siri' meaning 'prosperous, wealth'. It implies one who is victorious and prosperous in all aspects of life.

in_telugu.name: జైయశ్రీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name 'Jayashree' is a combination of the words 'Jai' meaning 'victorious' and 'Shree' meaning 'prosperous, wealthy'. It signifies one who is victorious in all aspects of life and is blessed with prosperity and wealth.

in_marathi.name: Jayashree
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayashree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of Victory, Prosperity, and Success
